rd-p1.title: Mia's Morning
rd-p1.text: Mia gets up at seven. She brushes her teeth. Then she has breakfast. She eats toast and she drinks orange juice. She doesn't drink milk. Mia goes to school at eight. She likes school.

rd-p2.title: Sam's Afternoon
rd-p2.text: Sam goes home at three. He does his homework at four. He doesn't watch TV in the afternoon. At five, he plays football in the park with Leo. Leo likes football too. They play every day.

rd-p3.title: Pepper the Cat
rd-p3.text: Pepper is Sam's cat. Pepper gets up at six. It drinks water and it eats fish. It doesn't go to school! It doesn't read books. It plays with a red ball. Sam likes cats.
